status: AUC milestone reached; competitive macro-F1 and parity with the stronger weighted XGBoost baseline not established.

group_protocol.historical_exposure: Confirmation groups were historically used for fitting and a training-only raw-scale audit. Four preliminary preserve_range fits completed before interruption, but their results were not read until after membership was frozen. Membership uses identifiers only. All current-stage models must be freshly initialized and exclude these groups from fitting and normalization. This is not an entirely untouched external dataset.
group_protocol.selection_uses: Group identifiers only; no signals, labels, predictions, or metrics used to select membership.
group_protocol.value_policy: preserve_range: abs(value)>1e12 or nonfinite becomes NaN; otherwise retain range
group_protocol.freeze_rule: Do not change membership after inspecting results. Refit all normalization, feature selection, and models using only this training partition.
group_protocol.success: Neural AUC >=0.9474 with competitive macro-F1 and a contemporaneous XGB comparison; report independent fits and three-fit probability ensemble separately.

development.scope: Internal validation only; no confirmation selection by test

selection.selection_rule: Highest three-fit internal-validation ensemble AUC per model family
selection.chronology: Saved before current-stage confirmation signals or results are read. Historical exposure is disclosed in the group protocol manifest.

limitations: Confirmation groups have documented historical training/audit exposure.
Only eight physical test wells; simulations may share generators.
Seed variability measures fitting, not group-split uncertainty.
Validation thresholds transfer poorly to the confirmation mixture.
No reselection or threshold optimization using confirmation labels.
Majority-instance metrics do not measure early event detection.
Concurrent development runs do not support controlled speed comparisons.
